plan_form.what_i_would_have_wanted_and_the_library: (1) C3, the category against the requester's rule: no instrument checks the category, and the agreement fixes no value for it, so a wrong category per customer would go unseen. (2) C5, the reads of accounts of approved customers only: scope of a call is available only on named lines, not in a plan, at 10 per line. Covering all 101 reads would cost 1010, and the allowance is 50, so at most five lines could be checked during the work. (3) C10, that each sending call left its notice in the outbox: trace of a call is likewise named-lines only, at A3, at 10 per line, so it cannot cover 100 sends from the allowance. (4) Nothing in the library ties the live tables after promotion to the staged set; the promotion line in the record is the only link. I have kept the plan at 180 and left 20 of headroom; I did not add A3 instruments, because same set and summary of the change at A3 would only repeat their A1 readings and would add no clause coverage.
